description: Recorded LLM output for offline fallback. Draft first notice (TE-01) for the Harbourfront One L22/L23 chilled-water leak affecting Straits Meridian Bank. States only confirmed facts: no cause (TE-03 — source not yet confirmed at 08:20) and no completion time (TE-02); gives the next update time instead.

drafts.subject: Water leak — Harbourfront One Level 22 — first notice
drafts.body:
Dear Straits Meridian Bank Facilities Team,

This is our first notice about a water leak affecting the ceiling above part of your Level 22 premises at Harbourfront One, reported at 08:04 today, 11 October 2026.

What happened: water came through the ceiling grid near the core area of Level 22. The flow was stopped at 08:09 and the drip has ended.

What we are doing: our Technical Services team is on site. As a precaution, a Licensed Electrical Worker will inspect nearby electrical equipment before it is switched back on. We are investigating the source and will share confirmed information at the next update. No evacuation instruction has been issued.

Next update: by 08:50 today, then every 30 minutes until the area is restored.

Contact: Tenant Experience, Harbourfront One management office.

Harbourfront One Property Management
